overview: Somov Rit is a star system in the Mid Rim Territories, within the Onatos Sector, at galactic grid R-15, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Somov Rit appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Mid Rim Territories.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Somov Rit's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Somov Rit is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Mid Rim Territories chart.
